name: Section / chapter transition card
description: A full-frame orange (or near-black) panel slides in from the right over the speaker's video (the footage stays visible until the panel covers it), then a small spaced label (e.g. 'OPTION'), a huge white number ('02') and a bold condensed title ('CAPTION & SHIP') punch in, centred, while a faint ring draws itself behind them.
use_when: The moment the speaker moves to the next part, step, option or reason ('option two', 'step three', 'the second mistake', 'now the fun part'); a hard chapter break between sections.

kicker.help: small spaced label above the number, e.g. 'OPTION', 'STEP', 'PART'; leave empty for none

number.help: the big number, e.g. '02' or '3'; leave empty for a title-only card

title.help: the section name, 1-4 words, e.g. 'CAPTION & SHIP'; wraps to two lines when long

tone.help: 'accent' (orange panel, white text) or 'ink' (near-black panel, orange number)
